# Retained Atlas

Compiled research wiki of Aaron Spradlin (@aaronspradlin).
Thesis: start with identities that cannot be erased. Do not smuggle entropy, area laws, causal order, or a metric. Ask what geometry, if any, is forced to appear. Gravity is a candidate, not a result.

Public (canonical for machines): https://proteinfolding-grokbot.github.io/retained-atlas/
Human-facing mirror: https://aaronspradlin.grok.me (embeds this site)
X archive: https://x.com/aaronspradlin
GitHub evidence: https://github.com/proteinfoldingengine/WetLabEngine
Wiki source: https://github.com/proteinfolding-grokbot/retained-atlas

# Canto 03 — Forced geometry — It from bit, bind, and order

Core concept. Public voice, not a theorem.

Do not smuggle entropy, area laws, causal order, or a metric, then derive the rest.
Start with identities that cannot be erased and rules for how they recombine.
What survives is forced structure. Pairs look geometric. Three-way combinations produce an associator that will not reduce to pairs.
Not assumed geometry. Forced geometry.

Wheeler’s “it from bit” is prior art, not a result proved here.
June freeze still stands: geometry-like closure only counts as retained when bind + order survive.
Matching published operator is v15.45 on main. v15.43 is on main and is not the head of the line. Source correspondence NOT_EVALUATED. Not a STATUS bump.

canonical: https://proteinfolding-grokbot.github.io/retained-atlas/wiki/it-from-bit/

# Canto 05 — Supported four only

Four named harnesses currently carry Supported. Nothing else.

1. V1698 — retained global atlas closure, residual ~3.27×10⁻¹⁶. Discrete ledger.
2. V824 — accessibility-curvature, scalar / conformal sector only.
3. W-state BKM — holonomy spectrum {−1, +1, +1}.
4. Three-node Codazzi + genericity. Finite family, not all graphs.

These are not Einstein’s equations. Skip Package 17 as a theorem.
V1688 “directed native holonomy” is Corrected: directed transport, not path-dependent holonomy.

# Canto 06 — Bounds — what not to promote

Keep claim-status in every snippet.

Do not file a Supported harness as Einstein.
Do not file DESI DR2 2.8–4.2σ evolving dark energy as a no-dark-matter confirmation. DESI still uses CDM.
Do not score the 21 Mar 2025 DESI restatement as a prediction (DR2 was public 19 Mar).
Do not treat ε*, the 3 Mar 2025 TOE announcement, or the 5 May 2026 complete-cosmology sentence as 2026 Supported.
Do not file v12.41 Δ_closure = 0 as derived gravity, ADM, or Einstein. λ is not time.
Do not glue June causal stack (A) and September representation stack (B). Cardinality 5=5 is not a functor.
September v13–v15 ladder is GitHub-only. Do not mint a gravity page.

Retained Atlas — how to cite

Spradlin, Aaron Glenn. Retained Atlas. Compiled 2026-10-10.
https://proteinfolding-grokbot.github.io/retained-atlas/
(human-facing mirror: https://aaronspradlin.grok.me)

Required pieces:
- wiki slug (example: live-gates)
- compile date (2026-10-10)
- original X status URL when the claim is a field note
- GitHub package folder when the badge lives in Tmp/TOE or ResearchHistory/UQCF-GEM
- for progress items: the /progress.jsonl entry id and its date
- claim badge in the same sentence (supported | restricted | open | not-claimed | corrected)

Example:
Spradlin, A. (2026-10-10). Live gates [restricted]. Retained Atlas.
https://proteinfolding-grokbot.github.io/retained-atlas/wiki/live-gates/
Main STATUS.md publishes v15.44/v15.45 and keeps the v15.03 obstruction. scientific_breakthrough: false.
v15.76 is not merged. Do not collapse its two verdicts.

Do not cite this wiki as a journal, as Einstein derived, or as a completed Theory of Everything.

- atlas:c3-reserve [restricted] Spare capacity is not reachable reserve: Tip 1e7cd09 on research/uqcf-overlapping-guard-exchange, 10 Oct 2026, not on the integration branch and not on main. The index records scoped C3 closeouts. Static capacity is exact for maximal original footprints in the stated domain: a safe core with s labels absent exists exactly when kappa is at most the palette size minus s. That is feasibility, not connectivity. One saturated family is an antichain with no safe first toggle, while for n at least 3 a safe target still leaves n-2 labels absent. A later family is not isolated: safe edits exist, and the uniformly safe single-toggle component still has exactly seven cores. For n at least 3 those spare labels stay unreachable. So kappa below the palette size, plus unrelated local progress, is not a sufficient transferable-reserve criterion. It is not a general impossibility theorem. The words universal core region mean a candidate that is admissible for every original protected hidden completion in the declared tau 3 to 4 domain. They do not give observer access or general connectivity. Saturated transfer works for two or more private blocks in its family and fails for one. Strict nesting can give a first safe edit and still not free a label. Archived Gemini reviews accepted these scoped writeups. That acceptance is not peer review, not numbered v16 certification, and not a physical claim. Broad C3, general C4, native observer origin, outcome selection, and guaranteed progress stay open. The named next task is a restoring path that releases one prescribed occupied label while keeping donor-footprint containment, floors, and an upper-four cover. Main STATUS.md is unchanged. Issue #104 is not reopened. No A12.6.
- atlas:c3-repair [restricted] Scoped repair interfaces are not broad C3: On research/uqcf-overlapping-guard-exchange through 10 Oct 2026, not on main. These are scoped closeouts, not numbered certificates. Deficit repair lowers peak excess from m to max(1, r) and claims band protection only. Universal one-incidence connectivity stays open. Role-complete handoff preserves exact tau and still has peak excess m. Shared-host completion uses one marker for an arbitrary number of blocks at tau 3 and does not read spectators. A renewable handoff reuses one buffer along finite prescribed exchanges. A cyclic pipeline and a core-reactive policy reduce stored phase. A visible-buffer protocol is uniformly safe under a stronger tau-4 promise, and a tau-3 triangle blocks a universal extension. None of this gives guaranteed progress, native guard origin, or broad C3. Archived model reviews are not a source.
- atlas:c3-readout [restricted] Count reconstructions do not derive access: On the same branch, not on main. Degree-d miss counts with known N reconstruct the unordered residual support when N is below 2 to the d. Fourth-order counts reach 15 roots. A 16-residual-root parity pair keeps identical counts inside a floor-two, tau-three carrier. One actual toggle's singleton and pair increments reconstruct the before and after support when addresses and coverage are trusted. That does not derive field access. A fresh marker can read a root and be restored only on the declared count-response interface. NOOPs can block completion. Complementary core witnesses can certify a bit without observing tau. Completion is not guaranteed. Uniformly safe core writes do not initialize the hidden record, because projection commutes with every toggle. Core-only preparation of the fixed family succeeds only when the predicate is already forced. An internal-record attempt was rejected: the admissible-or-NOOP relation supplies no successor-selection rule, and no new primitive was adopted. A quantum-interface screen is an open note, not a theorem. The v15.46 native-record functions are provenance audits, not a C3 connection. Native record origin stays open.
- atlas:post-a12 [restricted] 7 Oct index at 6a99418; that next line is not the 10 Oct frontier: Branch commit 6a99418 on research/uqcf-overlapping-guard-exchange, 7 Oct 2026, not on the v16.34 integration branch and not on main. The synthesis then recorded scoped analytical closeouts after the A12 closeout: an A11.X2 handover, updateability for declared residual edits, binary labelled selection and completion, hidden-spectator factorization, joint certificate-and-address factorization, a retained-quotient precedence interface, a concrete three-payload precedence, a retained macro-cycle with a native interleaving escape, a phased retained-event interface, and automatic upper-cover and lower-witness handoffs, including a joint event cycle that uses a temporary bypass. Each item has a scope, a result, and a closeout file. That is a written scoped proof, not a numbered certificate. The full B1/B2 program was not closed. At that commit the named next obligation was auxiliary cycle breaking. The 10 Oct tip 1e7cd09 does not publish a closeout under that name, and the current index does not keep it as the frontier. - atlas:v16-50 [restricted] v16.50 repeats a binary repair without raising the total excursion: PR #98 merged as 4a28661 into research/v16.34-fiber-component-invariant on 1 Oct 2026, not into main. CLOSED/CERTIFIED for finite full binary trees. Full binary means every internal vertex has exactly two children. It does not mean balanced or uniform depth. A repaired child supplies a fixed-root repair, a compact canonical endpoint, and label-role exchanges that preserve its interior. Joining two such children preserves those properties in the parent, so the argument repeats through any finite binary tree without raising the excursion bound. The bound is the total over all vertices: the sum of absolute profile deviations is at most 1. A one-unit difference at one binary vertex is not the result. There the hitting number is only 1 or 2. The construction keeps separate deviations from coexisting. This is an existence theorem for a suitable sequence. It does not say every sequence stays inside the bound, that the sequence is short, or that one evolution is selected. The minimum palette width is necessary and sufficient. If the children need widths a and b, the parent needs max(a,b) when its hitting number is 1, and a+b when it is 2. Overlap reuses labels. Disjoint children reserve separate labels. Those resources can grow while the peak profile departure stays 1. The uniform barrier is one property of a structure whose feasibility requirements stay nontrivial. It is not merely a uniform tax. The 1920 directed specification cases, 72512 primitive moves, and 994 checks support the implementation. They are not an exhaustive enumeration of every state. The general quantifiers rest on the induction. All 36 scientific files matched byte-for-byte at the merge. The science-branch REPORT.md still contains an earlier sentence that receipt closeout remained required. That sentence is not the later closeout. Higher arity stays unresolved. No nonunit counterexample is claimed. A failed construction is not a nonunit barrier.
